children: is lowering fees for many active traders on Coinbase Advanced, the company said Wednesday.

The new fee structure includes substantially lower rates on spot trading for many global clients. Furthermore, volume tiers now incorporate both spot and derivatives activity. Users can instantly qualify for VIP fees and benefits by holding USDC
on the platform. Coinbase members will continue to earn an unlimited 3.5% APY on USDC, the company added.

A member's tier is determined by the volume or balance criteria that's most favorable to the user. Advanced tiers start at $10K in qualifying volume, down from $25K previously. Rates vary by market, with the following spot entry-level tiers:
EU and UK: 0.25% maker and 0.50% taker.
Brazil, India, and other international markets: 0.09% maker and 0.10% taker.
stock fell 2.7% in late morning trading.

title: Coinbase reduces fees for many active traders on its Advanced platform
